lines.vo: What if you saved a little more every time you got a raise?
That's not a sacrifice. That's autopilot.
Rio plans his next savings bump in his Money Mastery Budget Planner.
In a well known workplace program, people agreed today to save more later, each time their pay went up.
Their savings rate started around three and a half percent.
After four raises, a bit over three years, it averaged roughly thirteen point six percent.
lines.cap: After 4 raises, a bit over 3 years, it averaged roughly 13.6%.

lines.vo: And because the bump came out of the raise, their take home pay didn't have to shrink.
A little more, every raise. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Do *this* every time you get a raise
